newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - BANGLADESH NEWSPAPERS - AUG 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - BANGLADESH NEWSPAPERS - AUG 7.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The Chittagong Port Authority will send a team to Singapore next week to pursue the feeder vessels operators to withdraw the decision to impose congestion surcharge at the port.
Prime Minister Shjeikh hasina returned home on Wednesday after staying abroad for 23 days.
The Burmese authorities have released 57 Bangladeshi fishermen after seven months in jail.
A seven-member Bangladesh delegation begins a three-day visit on Thursday to Indian state of Tripura to negotiate resumption of repatriation of tribal refugees.
The World Bank and the Asian Development Bank have launched a joint survey in the Sundarbans forest to ascertain the extent of damage caused to the mangrove forest by rising salinity.
Foreign Minister Abdus Samad Azad Azad starts a three-day visit to India from Thursday.
The government on Wednesday decided to take a package of measures to revamp the low-performing leather sector whose export earning last year dropped by over 30 percent.
South Korea is likley to relocate over 100 medium and small industrial units to Bangladesh. REUTER
